original_prompt_source: source paper main-text reaction case: methane combustion, GFN2-xTB, 400 K, dH ~ -12.51 eV. (The bundled dataset reaction_energy entries all report Gibbs free energy; no dH instance exists — see source_catalog.json 029 entry.)
original_reference_source: paper_text dH ~ -12.51 eV; species-level cross-check against dataset id=38 (CO2/H2O @400K, GFN2-xTB) agree to <1e-5 eV
note: G1: 029 source is the paper-text case (no dataset dH instance). Regenerated reference (pinned image) is authoritative; compared to paper ~ -12.51 eV.

fidelity_exception.reason: Two prompt/evaluator mismatches in 029, both because the reference pipeline's non-default settings were not written into the prompt: (1) O2 spin — the locked reference is generated with spin=0 (closed shell / singlet) for ALL species, mirroring the source ase_core pipeline; gas-phase O2 ground state is a triplet, and an agent that 'correctly' picks triplet O2 (spin=2) produces dH ~0.14 eV off the reference and fails. (2) geometry convergence — evaluator L5 requires max_i ||F_i|| < 0.01 eV/A on delivered geometries, but the prompt did not specify a cutoff, so an agent using the reasonable fmax=0.02 delivered a CO2 structure above that threshold even though all reported H/G/S and dH matched the reference. Neither failure is a reference-generation error nor evidence the model cannot solve the task — both were unspecified non-default settings in the prompt.
fidelity_exception.resolution: instruction.md now requires: (1) spin=0 for all species including O2, and (2) max_i ||F_i|| < 0.01 eV/A for every delivered geometry. ASE BFGS with fmax=0.01 and at most 1000 steps is the pinned reference workflow, not a required optimizer; alternatives meeting the same observable criterion are accepted. Reference values are unchanged.
fidelity_exception.future_note: To benchmark chemistry judgment (choosing the physically correct triplet O2 and/or a looser-but-valid optimization cutoff), create separate variants with their own regenerated references rather than altering 029.
